title: Atonement
definition: The atonement is the saving work of Christ by which He offered Himself on the cross for sinners, bearing judgment, satisfying justice, reconciling us to God, and securing forgiveness through His blood.
summary: The cross is not merely an example of love; it is the place where Christ dealt with sin. He died in the sinner’s place, making peace through His blood and opening the way to God.
christFocus: The object of saving faith is Christ and Him crucified. Victory, forgiveness, reconciliation, and new life flow from what Jesus accomplished at the cross.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Atonement includes sacrifice, substitution, redemption, reconciliation, and propitiation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Christ offered Himself willingly and completely.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The believer’s confidence rests not in personal merit but in the finished work of Christ.
